text: Fixing #5916 (path dot names): real VFP9 matrix (21 names x 6 ext args, retained at ~/temp/vfp9-probes/path-funcs-6580/vfp9-result-dots.txt) shows JUSTSTEM/JUSTEXT split at the LAST dot with no leading-dot exception; FORCEEXT returns '' for an empty stem, drops one leading dot from the ext and keeps a bare dot for '.'; DEFAULTEXT leaves any name containing a dot unchanged. Fail-first: 146 failures before, 0 after. The shared portable_path_stem() stays unchanged because database-designator matching uses it (an empty stem for '.x' names would let unrelated databases match); the PRG functions use their own VFP-exact helpers, with a test pinning the designator helper.
